fact: At the launch of the National E-Health project on 31 October 2024 the Vice President said LHIMS was deployed in about 481 facilities - all six teaching hospitals, 10 regional hospitals, 243 district hospitals, three psychiatric hospitals and 50 polyclinics - with deployment to over 1,000 health centres ongoing.
title: Veep launches National E-Health project to transform Ghana’s healthcare system
